Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red. Product measurements: length 20 cm, width 20 cm, height 15 cm. Product weight: 0.3 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.

Reusable design allows for careful cleaning and storage between festive occasions.
Hanging format lets you spread ornaments through branches or combine with other displays.
Red colour pairs well with plain finishes to keep smaller design elements visible.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 1x Christmas Bauble
Hanger included

5058194865405.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: PVC. Colour: Gold. Stated size: 6 Cm. Quantity: 1 set.
Shatter resistant PVC construction provides a safe and durable alternative to traditional glass ornaments for festive decorating.
Lightweight design ensures easy handling and convenient storage, allowing effortless placement on tree branches or in gift bags.
Classic gold finish adds a touch of elegance and colour to your Christmas tree, coordinating beautifully with other seasonal displays.
Each set includes six centimetre baubles designed to create a focal point while maintaining their defined shape and festive appeal.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 1 set of Christmas baubles
Hanger included

Checked Pattern
The checked pattern provides a regular repeating design. It adds visual detail while keeping the overall appearance coordinated.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Add wine red colour and contrasting texture to your Christmas decorations with this pack of 6 matching 10cm thread ball baubles. Each round ornament has a thread-wrapped surface with a gold sequin band around the middle, bringing together fine lines and reflective detail in one design. A hanging loop above the decorative cap provides a way to position the bauble on a suitable tree branch or include it in a wreath or garland arrangement. The 10cm size creates a visible accent among foliage, ribbons and other hanging ornaments, while the wine red finish helps you coordinate a consistent seasonal colour scheme. Use the matching pieces to repeat the design across the tree, or combine with your own plain and patterned decorations for a varied display. These Christmas tree ornaments also work in indoor window arrangements, mantel greenery, winter wedding decorations and festive party displays. This option contains 6 baubles, with the same thread covering and sequin-band design on each piece. Display the band facing forward so its sequin detail remains visible between branches.

Sequin Band Detail: The gold band contrasts with the wine red thread covering, combining a textured finish with reflective sequin detail. Place these decorative Christmas balls among foliage and ribbons to add a different surface beside plain baubles in your seasonal arrangement.
Hanging Tree Ornaments: A loop above the decorative cap provides a hanging point for each bauble. Position the 10cm ornaments on suitable branches or incorporate them into a wreath or garland, spacing them between other decorations so the thread texture and sequin band remain visible.
Coordinated Christmas Decor: Use the wine red colour to build a consistent tree theme, or combine the baubles with contrasting ornaments and ribbon. The round shape suits traditional Christmas decorations, winter wedding displays and festive party arrangements around the home.

5096042276805.sourceDescription:
A flexible 5 m string of 50 warm white LEDs accompanies the 45 cm green wreath. Wind it through the pine-style branches to distribute the lights yourself or concentrate more of them near a favourite decoration.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes. If you already have lighting in the same part of the room, see how the two colours look together at dusk before choosing the final position.

Fine pine-style sprigs lend themselves to a simple woodland scheme. A plain background keeps the outline of the needles visible, especially where the foliage spreads towards the edge of the decoration.

A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room. Try holding the wreath against a light wall and then against a darker door before fixing the hanging point. View the arrangement in daylight first, then turn on the lights with the room lighting lowered. The two views can look quite different, and a small change in position often makes the points of light easier to see.

A lit wreath can provide the evening detail in a hallway where there is little space for a tree. Keeping the surface below it simple lets the outline show up after dark and leaves room for the everyday use of the entrance. For a window display, test the position from both sides of the glass before making it permanent. Moving the decoration slightly away from a bright reflection can make the individual lights much clearer in the evening.

When dressing an entrance, allow for the full movement of the door as well as the width of the decoration.

Features a 45 cm green pine-style wreath with realistic sprig details.
Versatile design suitable for hanging on doors, walls, or windows.
Warm white LED lights create a festive atmosphere in any setting.
Comes with 5 m string of 50 warm white LEDs

5096042277505.variantName: Christmas welcome wreath - Wooden door sign - Woven Welcome sign with Father Christmas for a hallway or front door - Wood, 25 cm
5096042277505.sourceDescription:
A woven wooden surround frames Father Christmas, a reindeer and a tree. The WELCOME lettering gives the 25 cm decoration a purpose at the entrance, with a small scene for visitors to look at while they wait.

The greeting gives the wreath a clear role at an entrance. The small Christmas scene adds detail around the words, so the sign works at two distances, first as a welcome and then as a picture to see while standing at the door.

A narrow ribbon in a colour taken from the design makes a discreet finishing touch if you use your own hanger. Varying the length of the ribbon lets you line up the centre of the wreath with a panel or a nearby mirror. When dressing an entrance, allow for the full movement of the door as well as the width of the decoration. Set it clear of the handle, letter plate and frame so the arrangement stays in position as people come and go.

A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations. To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together.

If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them. A little breathing room around its edge usually shows the shapes more clearly than placing several pieces edge to edge. For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards.
Woven wooden surround frames a festive Father Christmas, reindeer and tree motif.
Compact 25 cm diameter size is ideal for hallways or front door decoration.
Features clear WELCOME lettering with detailed Christmas scene for visual appeal.
Includes a discreet ribbon finish allowing easy custom hanging and alignment.
Hanging rope included

The self adhesive backing provides a direct way to attach the item to a compatible surface. Prepare the surface and align the position before pressing it into place.

Care and presentation

5031470302405.sourceDescription:
Bring a snowy festive feel to your home with this Snow Flocked Pre-Lit Christmas Garland. Available in 6ft and 9ft sizes, it’s beautifully illuminated by LEDs to add a magical glow to doorways, banisters, windowsills, and fireplaces.

COLOUR SWITCH LEDS & LIGHT EFFECTS: Switch from warm white to multi-coloured LEDs to set the perfect festive mood. From gentle fades and twinkles to colour-changing displays, choose from a variety of light effects, with a memory chip remembering your last setting.

REALISTIC SNOW FLOCKED STYLE: Crafted with flocked dual-toned PVC needles, the garland captures the look of real snow-dusted foliage for a magical wintry look. Soft tapered tips add texture and depth for a full, natural finish, creating a stunning frosted backdrop for the LEDs.

BATTERY POWERED WITH TIMER: Powered by an IP44-rated battery pack, the garland can be displayed indoors or outdoors without worrying about plugging it in. A built-in timer conveniently switches the LEDs on at the same time every evening, then turns them off six hours later.

LOOPS FOR EASY HANGING: Durable metal loops on both ends make the garland easy to hang around doors, banisters, fireplaces, and more. Coloured green to blend with the foliage, the loops also make it easy to tie more than one garland together for a longer display.

Specifications
Available Sizes: 6ft / 9ft
LED Count: 40 (6ft), 50 (9ft)
Colour Switch LEDs: Warm white and multi-colour
Timer Function: 6 hours on / 18 hours off
Snow flocked pre-lit garland for indoor or outdoor display
Warm white & multi-colour LEDs with built-in colour switch
IP44-rated battery pack with timer (6 hours on / 18 hours off)
140 / 200 flocked tapered PVC tips for a full festive look
Available in 6ft and 9ft lengths with loops for easy hanging
Guarantee - 1 year

5059442168705.sourceDescription:
Hugely popular in America and increasingly loved in the UK, the Fraser Fir is chosen for its dense, bushy, silvery-green foliage and soft needles that are kind on hands when decorating. It gives off a sweet, citrusy scent that fills your home for as long as the tree is indoors, and its strong, upward-angled branches make decorating easy and hold heavier ornaments without trouble. Fraser Firs have excellent needle retention as long as they are kept well watered. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
